title: BRFSS 2025 Diabetes Survey
subtitle: Official CDC BRFSS 2025 public-use survey archive for diabetes ML research
description: Official 2025 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) public-use SAS Transport archive published by the U.S. CDC. This Kaggle dataset is a private working copy for reproducible exploratory analysis and model development. Source documentation: https://www.cdc.gov/brfss/annual_data/annual_2025.html. License is marked as Other; users should follow the CDC's applicable public-use terms and documentation.

resources.description: Original CDC BRFSS 2025 SAS Transport ZIP archive, preserved byte-for-byte.
